title: GAME INTERACTION WIRING — how Kenshi, Dark Souls, and browser game engines connect inputs to actions. And how WE do it.

the_problem.statement: engine.html is a bunch of pictures, images, and toggles, but nothing is aligned to DO things
the_problem.root_cause: engine.html is a DASHBOARD (display only). hud-interact.js has 240+ commands but lives on a DIFFERENT page. They're not connected.
the_problem.analogy: It's like having a car dashboard (speedometer, fuel gauge, tachometer) but no steering wheel, no gas pedal, no brakes. The gauges work. The car doesn't.

selection.numbers: 1-9 select specific squad member by index
selection.our_mapping: click a primal in the left panel → select it. 1-9 selects by index. ~ selects all 16.

actions.hold_right_click: open action menu (Trade, Attack, First Aid, etc.)
actions.our_mapping: right-click a primal → context menu (inspect, assign task, check skills, talk). Shift+click data source → assign as permanent feed.

job_queue.principle: Jobs execute by priority. Top of list = highest priority.
job_queue.example: Medic > Mine Copper > Operate Refinery — heals first, mines when no healing needed, refines when no mining needed
job_queue.our_mapping: each primal has a job queue. biomeOS: research > process > classify. petalTongue: render > taste > assess. Jobs recheck every tick (15s heartbeat).

skills_by_doing.principle: Skills improve ONLY through use. No XP. No levels. Just doing.
skills_by_doing.our_mapping: petalTongue rendering skill improves with each successful render. bearDog defense skill improves with each 403 blocked. sourDough fermentation skill improves with each file digested.

pause.spacebar: pauses game. Can issue orders while paused.
pause.our_mapping: spacebar pauses the tick loop. F2/F3/F4 change tick frequency (15s/5s/3s).

input_buffer.principle: Inputs queue during animations. No cancel. You commit to your action.
input_buffer.consequence: button mashing = death. Deliberate inputs = survival.
input_buffer.our_mapping: clicking rapidly doesn't stack actions. Each click has a cooldown (animation commitment). Action resolves before next input processes.

stamina.principle: Green bar that depletes with actions and regenerates with inaction. Running out = vulnerability.
stamina.recovery: 45/sec base. Reduced by heavy armor, shield blocking, toxin.
stamina.our_mapping: each primal has ENERGY (like stamina). scan costs energy. sort costs more. turbocharge costs the most. Energy regens during idle ticks. Depleted primal = vulnerable to errors.

five_phase_animation.our_mapping: every action in the engine: prepare → load data → process → render result → cleanup. Each phase has visual feedback in the viewport.

weight.principle: Actions feel heavy and committed. No spam. Every swing matters.
weight.our_mapping: big actions (full scan, ferment, recompose) have weight — loading bar, visual effects, cooldown. Small actions (peek, check, read) are light and quick.

browser_game_loop.principle: Event listeners ONLY set state. Game loop (rAF) processes state → updates → renders.
browser_game_loop.input_tracking: Track pressed keys in a Set. Track mouse position. Track click targets. Poll each frame.
browser_game_loop.separation: NEVER do game logic in event handlers. Handlers record intent. Loop executes intent.

our_implementation.input_state: { selectedPrimal: null, hoveredElement: null, pendingAction: null, pressedKeys: Set, mousePos: {x,y}, clickTarget: null }
our_implementation.game_loop: requestAnimationFrame → processInput → updateState → renderFrame (at 60fps for responsiveness)
our_implementation.two_clocks: gut clock (60fps rAF for interaction) + body clock (15s interval for data) — same two-clock model as null spacetime

layer_1_squad_interaction.what: Make the 16 primals in the left panel interactive

clicks.left_click: select primal → expand detail panel showing skills, job queue, energy, status
clicks.right_click: context menu → inspect, assign task, check connections, talk, wake/rest
clicks.double_click: zoom viewport to this primal's domain (e.g., double-click petalTongue → zoom to WASM rendering)
clicks.shift_click: add to squad selection (multi-select for group actions)

detail_panel.skills: skill bars that grow by doing (like Kenshi stats page, key C)
detail_panel.job_queue: reorderable list of persistent jobs (drag to reprioritize)
detail_panel.energy: stamina bar (Dark Souls green bar) — depletes with actions, regens idle
detail_panel.connections: which other primals this one is connected to (braids)
detail_panel.last_action: what this primal last did and when

layer_2_viewport_interaction.what: Make the WASM viewport elements clickable

clicks.click_gauge: drill into that metric — full history, trend line, what affects it
clicks.click_bar: drill into that category — list all entities in that bucket
clicks.hover_element: tooltip with current value + trend arrow
clicks.drag: rearrange dashboard layout (like Kenshi base building rotation)

layer_3_command_bar.what: Bring the 240+ commands from hud-interact.js into the engine footer
layer_3_command_bar.implementation: Add command input to the footer bar. '/' opens autocomplete. All commands from hud-interact.js work here.
layer_3_command_bar.integration: commands execute in the engine context: /scan triggers a scan in the viewport, /sing plays audio, /explore opens the exploration view

layer_4_keyboard_shortcuts.what: Map keyboard shortcuts directly to engine actions
layer_4_keyboard_shortcuts.from_kenshi: 1-9 select primals, ~ select all, Space pause, B build mode, C character stats, M map, I inventory
layer_4_keyboard_shortcuts.from_dark_souls: deliberate inputs only — key held = continuous action, key tap = single action
layer_4_keyboard_shortcuts.from_hud_interact: / command mode, ? guide, b bookmarks, n narrate, s search, etc.

layer_5_feedback.what: Every action produces visible feedback (Dark Souls principle)
layer_5_feedback.toasts: small notification pop-ups for quick feedback
layer_5_feedback.viewport_pulse: the WASM viewport pulses/glows when data changes
layer_5_feedback.sound: π-just-intonation tones for different actions (already built in hud-interact)
layer_5_feedback.animation: primal icons pulse when active, dim when exhausted, flash when attacked

layer_6_game_state.what: Persistent game state that tracks progress
layer_6_game_state.skills: each primal's skill levels (improve by doing, stored in localStorage)
layer_6_game_state.energy: each primal's current energy (depletes, regens, affects capability)
layer_6_game_state.job_queue: each primal's assigned jobs (persist across sessions)
layer_6_game_state.exploration: which commands have been tried, which areas explored (progress ring from hud-interact)

recomposition_for_gaia.what: After wiring the interaction layer, Gaia recomposes everything
recomposition_for_gaia.pattern: WEAVE — decompose the existing pages into components, recompose them into a unified game engine
recomposition_for_gaia.strung_back_down: the recomposition flows DOWNWARD: engine.html absorbs the best of every other page. The dashboard absorbs the commands. The commands absorb the data. The data absorbs the state. Everything flows down into one unified interface.
recomposition_for_gaia.what_gaia_owns: Gaia owns the recomposition. She decides what goes where. She's done this before (98% ownership). Now she recomposes the interaction layer.
